Marking Roborock's 12th anniversary, the high-tech cleaning company is rolling out anniversary promotions from now through September 6, with generous discounts on its robot vacuums and other products.

This anniversary sale covers a wide range of products and bundles, with discounts ranging from 25% to over 50%, and savings of up to US$1,600...

Saros 20

The Saros 20 pictured above is Roborock's flagship smart robot cleaner, featuring unprecedented real-world intelligence designed for the spatial scale and layout complexity of larger North American homes. Key features include the StarSight Autonomous System 2.0, AdaptiLift Chassis 3.0, a carpet intelligence system, and Smart Plan 3.0.

StarSight is the most advanced autonomous navigation system on the market, combining dual-emitter solid-state LiDAR with 3D time-of-flight technology to map highly detailed 3D floor plans of the home and reliably identify and avoid over 300 types of obstacles, from stray cables to pets.

The AdaptiLift Chassis is an advanced system that recognises door thresholds and steps in the room, then uses an electric mechanical leg to automatically lift the Saros 20 over obstacles, ensuring uninterrupted whole-home cleaning. The carpet intelligence system automatically adjusts the body height to maintain optimal suction, delivering deep cleaning on carpets with pile up to 3 cm.

Smart Plan 2.0 is an AI-powered intelligent cleaning system that analyses the home's unique layout, flooring types, and the daily habits of everyone in the household, automatically optimising cleaning routes accordingly.

Qrevo 2 Pro

Making its debut in the US market, the all-new Qrevo 2 Pro is the ultimate robot cleaner for pet households. Designed to tackle stubborn stains and pet hair, it features a dual zero-tangle system paired with 20,000 Pa of suction to achieve 100% hair removal with absolutely zero tangles. This robot cleaner easily handles pet hair and dander, cat litter, cereal crumbs, and muddy paw prints.

One of the most challenging scenarios is pets and long-pile carpets coexisting. The Qrevo 2 Pro comes with an auto-detaching mop function that leaves the mop pads at the dock, keeping carpets completely dry and effortlessly tackling this dilemma.

F25 Steam

The F25 Steam is the ultimate handheld wet-and-dry cleaner, combining 25,000 Pa of suction with 356°F VaporFlow steam cleaning.

Key features include up to 80 minutes of whole-home cleaning endurance, a 180-degree flat-lay design for reaching under furniture, blue light illumination to reveal hidden dust, and full automated steam self-cleaning with hot-air drying after cleaning is complete.

F25 XT

If you're after powerful wet-and-dry cleaning without the steam function, the F25 XT delivers 20,000 Pa of suction and features SlideTech 2.0 gliding technology rollers for a smoother, easier cleaning experience.

The F25 XT provides true edge-to-edge wet-and-dry cleaning, delivering flawless results in a single pass. The JawScrapers roller brush features shark-tooth blade anti-tangle bristles that effectively grab hair, while a constant-pressure squeegee ensures no water streaks are left on the floor. It also features a 180-degree flat-lay design and offers 60 minutes of battery life (in eco mode), capable of cleaning up to 4,400 square feet on a single charge.

More Deals

The Qrevo S Pro and two of our most popular bundles are also enjoying generous discounts:

  • Qrevo S Pro: Originally US$699.99, now US$429.99 — save US$270 (38% off)
  • Saros 20 + F25GT Bundle: Originally US$1,899.99, now US$1,269.98 — save US$630 (33% off)
  • Qrevo S Pro + F25GT Bundle: Originally US$999.98, now US$549.98 — save US$450 (45% off)

All promotional prices end September 6 — don't hesitate, act now.
